title: 第三章 藏书阁
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
叶希文也不浪费时间，立刻控制着特殊空间中的神念开始修炼《明玉功》，顿时无数的信息顿时涌上了心头，现实中的修为也在连连突破。
叶希文顿时大喜，看来，自己所猜测的没有错。
叶希文停了下来，从那个神秘的空间中出来，修炼《明玉功》的事情先放到一边，现在还有一件很重要的事情要做，那就是先挑选武技，一个武者如果不会武技的话，那还怎么算的上是一个武者。
尤其是和敌人搏斗的时候，不会武技根本就不行，光有内功而没有武技，只能是被人完虐的下场。
天已经亮了，叶希文梳洗一下，前往父母的院子中吃早餐，这是叶家的习惯，即便是叶家三个孩子已经成年搬出去住了，但是如果不在家也就算了，在家三餐必然是在一起吃的。
叶希文到的时候，父母和哥哥姐姐都已经到齐了，就等他一个了。
“昨天晚上连晚饭都没回来吃，你去哪里了？”叶空明问道，叶空明是一个面容肃穆的中年男子。
“孩儿去修炼了！”叶希文自然不敢把那个神秘空间的事情都抖落出来，“我要告诉父亲一个好消息！”
叶空明眼中闪过一丝奇怪的神色，问道：“什么好消息？”
“是啊，是啊，快说，小弟，什么好事儿啊！”叶希文的二姐，叶茹雪连忙问道，她天生一副娃娃脸，虽然已经超过二十岁了，但是也就和十五六岁差不多，看着比叶希文还小。
闻言大哥叶枫也转过头看向叶希文，叶枫面容酷似叶空明，犹如是年轻版的叶空明，俊朗的外貌配上一身白衫，看过去潇洒无比。
兄妹三人年纪相差不大，从小一起长大，感情极好。
叶希文的母亲夏春雪虽然已经年过四十，但是多年养尊处优，加上身怀武功，驻颜有术，看上去，不过是二十出头罢了，只是含笑看着一大家子，虽然叶希文只是养子，但是在她心中却与亲子无异。
“我想学武技了！”叶希文笑着说道。
“学武技，你突破到了四重了？”叶空明一愣，随即反应过来说道，又扫了叶希文一眼，顿时明了。“不错！”
叶空明也没觉得有什么，毕竟原本叶希文就是第三重后期的实力，现在突破到第四重也没什么奇怪的。
不过他绝对想不到，叶希文是在一夜之间从第三重后期突破到了第四重。
夏春雪也是笑着点点头，虽然只是从后天三重突破到了后天四重，但是叶希文的每一点进步她都很欣喜。
一家人都很欣喜，并没有觉得有什么，因为无论是叶枫还是叶茹雪突破的速度都比叶希文要快的多了。
叶希文这时候突破很正常。

“等一下吃了饭，孩儿就想去藏书阁挑选武技！”叶希文笑着说道，按照一元宗的规矩，突破到后天四重之后，就可以进藏书阁挑选一本武技，不过只能是初级的武技，这次挑选武技，都是免费的，也只有这一次，以后如果还想要学习什么武功的话，就必须要以积分来换了，这些积分是所有宗门都有的，一般都是用各种功劳或者天材地宝来兑换。
“恩，去吧，不过这个武技你要好好挑选，现在你还是打基础的阶段，不可能选太多的武技，所以在很长一段时间内，都将用这门武技！”叶空明说道。
一门武技从开始学习到最后练至大成，一般人少说都要十年以上，哪怕只是一门初级武学，就算是天才，也需要一两年的时间。
叶空明的意思是贪多嚼不烂一门武技练到大成威力都是不可小觑的，如果还没有修炼到巅峰就不断的学习的话，最后只能是贪多嚼不烂，样样会，样样松。
叶希文点点头说道：“孩儿知道！”
叶希文知道，叶空明是老成谋国之言，对于贪多嚼不烂的道理，他也是知道的。
“孩儿还有一件事情想说！”叶希文问道。
“说吧！”叶空明脸上泛出笑容，叶希文突破，他心中一很是高兴。
“接下来的一段时间，孩儿想进入青峰山后山中修行，尽快巩固目前的境界，也是为了磨练武技！”叶希文说道，叶希文想过了，内功可以在安静的地方修炼，但是武技的话，还是要在搏斗之中，才能了解精髓，才能飞速进步。

content_en:
Ye Xiwen did not waste any time, and immediately controlled the spiritual thoughts in the special space and began to practice "Mingyu Gong". Immediately, countless information suddenly flooded into his mind, and his cultivation base in reality was also making breakthroughs one after another.
Ye Xiwen was immediately overjoyed. It seemed that his guess was correct.
Ye Xiwen stopped and came out of the mysterious space. He put aside the matter of practicing "Ming Yu Gong" for now. There is still one very important thing to do, which is to choose martial arts first. If a warrior does not know martial arts, how can he be considered a warrior.
Especially when fighting the enemy, it is useless if you don't know martial arts. Having internal strength but no martial arts can only end up being completely tortured.
It was already dawn. Ye Xiwen freshened up and went to have breakfast in his parents' yard. This was the habit of the Ye family. Even if the three children of the Ye family had moved out as adults, it didn't matter if they were not at home. They must eat three meals together at home.
When Ye Xiwen arrived, his parents, brothers and sisters were already here, just waiting for him.
"You didn't even come back for dinner last night. Where did you go?" Ye Kongming asked, a middle-aged man with a solemn face.
"The child has gone to practice!" Ye Xiwen naturally did not dare to reveal everything about that mysterious space, "I want to tell father some good news!"
A strange look flashed in Ye Kongming's eyes, and he asked, "What's the good news?"
"Yes, yes, come on, little brother, what's so good!" Ye Xiwen's second sister, Ye Ruxue, asked quickly. She was born with a baby face. Although she was over twenty years old, she was only about fifteen or sixteen years old, and she looked younger than Ye Xiwen.
Hearing this, the eldest brother Ye Feng also turned to look at Ye Xiwen. Ye Feng's face looked exactly like Ye Kongming, like a younger version of Ye Kongming. His handsome appearance paired with a white shirt made him look very chic.
The three brothers and sisters are not much different in age. They grew up together and have a very good relationship.
Although Ye Xiwen's mother Xia Chunxue is over forty years old, she has been pampered for many years. With her martial arts skills and good looks, she looks like she is only in her early twenties. She just looks at the large family with a smile. Although Ye Xiwen is only an adopted son, she is no different from her parent-child.
"I want to learn martial arts!" Ye Xiwen said with a smile.
"Learning martial arts, have you broken through to the fourth level?" Ye Kongming was stunned for a moment, then reacted and said, glancing at Ye Xiwen again, he suddenly understood. "Not bad!"
Ye Kongming didn't think it was a big deal. After all, Ye Xiwen was originally strong in the late third level, so it's not surprising that he has now broken through to the fourth level.
However, he never expected that Ye Xiwen would break through from the late third level to the fourth level overnight.
Xia Chunxue also smiled and nodded. Although she only broke through from the acquired third level to the acquired fourth level, she was delighted with every bit of Ye Xiwen's progress.
The whole family was very happy and didn't think anything was wrong, because both Ye Feng and Ye Ruxue broke through much faster than Ye Xiwen.
It was normal for Ye Xiwen to break through at this time.
"After dinner, the child wants to go to the Library Pavilion to choose martial arts!" Ye Xiwen said with a smile. According to the rules of the Yiyuan Sect, after breaking through to the acquired fourth level, you can enter the Library Pavilion to choose a martial arts, but it can only be elementary martial arts. This selection of martial arts is free, and it is only this time. If you want to learn any martial arts in the future, you must exchange it with points. These points are available to all sects, and are usually exchanged for various merits or natural treasures.
"Well, go ahead, but you have to choose this martial skill carefully. You are still in the basic stage, and it is impossible to choose too many martial arts, so you will use this martial skill for a long time!" Ye Kongming said.
It usually takes more than ten years for most people to learn a martial art from the beginning to the final practice, even if it is just one.Even if you are a genius, it will take a year or two to learn elementary martial arts.
What Ye Kongming meant was that the power of a martial arts skill should not be underestimated even if it is practiced to its full potential. If you continue to learn before it has reached its peak, you will end up biting off more than you can chew, mastering everything and being lax in everything.
Ye Xiwen nodded and said, "My child knows!"
Ye Xiwen knew that Ye Kongming was a veteran in planning for the country, and he also knew that he could chew more than he could chew.
"My child, there is one more thing I want to say!" Ye Xiwen asked.
"Say it!" A smile appeared on Ye Kongming's face. Ye Xiwen broke through, and he was very happy in his heart.
"In the next period of time, I want to enter the mountains behind Qingfeng Mountain to practice and consolidate my current state as soon as possible. It is also to hone my martial arts skills!" Ye Xiwen said. Ye Xiwen had thought about it. Internal skills can be practiced in a quiet place, but as for martial arts, you still have to fight to understand the essence and make rapid progress.
